We made it to Monday! It's **Swin** again. If you're living in the U.S., you
woke up this morning to our nation very much at war. No, I'm not talking about
_[that](https://zeteo.com/p/scoop-trumps-iran-war-has-burned)_[
war](https://zeteo.com/p/scoop-trumps-iran-war-has-burned). Or [that
one](https://zeteo.com/p/trumps-violent-crackdowns-on-us-cities). Or
[that](https://zeteo.com/p/is-cuba-next) [other
one](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/08/20/us/politics/trump-cuba-
sanctions.html). Or [this war](https://zeteo.com/p/why-is-no-one-talking-
about-the-new)… Nope, [not that one](https://zeteo.com/p/trumps-illegal-boat-
bombings-not-working), either. I'm referring to the _other_ insanely stupid
war that **President Donald Trump** is forcing his fellow Americans to go
along with - the one he's waging on our neighbors to the north.

In today's '**First Draft** ,' we'll get right to the point about Trump's
latest endless war; just because the bombs aren't falling in this one (yet?)
does not make the damage any less substantial or consequential. Plus, **Hakeem
Jeffries** takes more fire over a secret meeting with **Jared Kushner** and
the Trump administration prepares for its "Economic D-Day" with Iran. Let's
read in.

What happened this weekend wasn't just folly and 'Idiocracy.' It was a scandal
- an imperialistic disgrace that's been going on far too long.

Donald Trump and his administration are waging a full-blown economic war [on
Canada](https://zeteo.com/p/how-pissed-off-are-canadians-at-trump). We are
living in 2026 and in the real world, not in 1995 and in a poorly reviewed
Michael Moore [movie](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4jf8Bt4gD9Y), or in 1999
in the 'South Park' movie. So why, then, is the U.S. at **"[
war](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/08/22/world/canada/carney-tariffs-trade-
trump.html)"** with Canada?

The simple but correct answer is that for the past year and a half, America
has been ruled by an astonishingly violent airhead who likes starting
[wars](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-venezuela-mexico-invasion-attack-cartels)
that pretty much no one asked for - even if those wars
[mangle](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-advisers-worry-he-could-sink) the U.S.
economy.

Almost right after he stepped back into the White House last year, the
tariffs-obsessed Trump unleashed economic warfare on our longtime Canadian
allies, for self-destructive and [made-
up](https://www.npr.org/2025/03/04/nx-s1-5317494/tariffs-fentanyl-canada-
mexico-trump) reasons. Trump's attempted strong-arming led to Canada's leader
[declaring an end
to](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mark_Carney%27s_Davos_speech) the U.S.-led
global order as we knew it. That warfare reached its latest, deranged state
this past weekend, when trade talks imploded [in spectacular
fashion](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/08/22/us-canada-trade-
deal-01046788).
